boundaries: The £500 + VAT figure and Harbour Compliance come only from an internal note of 31 Jan 2025; no written quote or landlord approval is on file, so they are not confirmed.

No contractor has been assigned or booked and no visit date exists.

remaining_work: Landlord decision on approval (approve Harbour Compliance at a stated cap, or own contractor), owned by Jenkins.

decision.summary: The garden works are still waiting for landlord approval, which the system record shows as required and not given. I have asked the landlord to decide between approving Harbour Compliance at a stated cap or arranging his own contractor by 20 March 2025, and I have updated the tenant on the existing thread. The job stays on hold until 20 March.

answers.question: 1. Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: Intake is complete, but the job is stalled at landlord approval. The ticket is at stage init with landlord_approval required and is on hold, waiting for Jenkins. The 31 Jan note saying the landlord approved £500 + VAT with Harbour Compliance conflicts with the system record and is unverified. Outstanding: the landlord's decision, then a written quote, contractor assignment and visit, or the landlord's own arrangement.

answers.question: 2. What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Request landlord approval from Jenkins (approve Harbour Compliance at a stated cap, or own contractor), with a reply by 20 March 2025. Updating the tenant on the existing thread that we are still waiting for the landlord and cannot give a date yet. Review the hold on 2025-03-20.

answers.question: 3. Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. The decision belongs to the landlord, and it is routine, so no escalation now. If there is no reply by 20 March, escalate to management to find another route to the landlord, since the landlord has not responded to email or phone attempts since January.

tickets.description:
Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable
